337:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
338:             Time series dataset.
339: 
340:         Returns
341:         -------
342:         array of shape=(n_ts, ) or (n_ts, n_classes), depending on the shape
343:         of the label vector provided at training time.
344:             Index of the cluster each sample belongs to or class probability
345:             matrix, depending on what was provided at training time.
346:         """
347:         sklearn_X, y, nb_features = self._preprocess_sklearn(X, fit_time=False)
348:         estimator = self.svm_estimator_.predict(sklearn_X)
349:         self.n_features_in_ = nb_features
350:         return estimator
351: 
352:     def decision_function(self, X):
353:         """Evaluates the decision function for the samples in X.
354: 
355:         Parameters
356:         ----------
357:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
358:             Time series dataset.
359: 
360:         Returns
361:         -------
362:         ndarray of shape (n_samples, n_classes * (n_classes-1) / 2)
363:             Returns the decision function of the sample for each class
364:             in the model.
365:             If decision_function_shape='ovr', the shape is (n_samples,
366:             n_classes)."""
367:         sklearn_X, *_ = self._preprocess_sklearn(X, fit_time=False)
368:         return self.svm_estimator_.decision_function(sklearn_X)
369: 
370:     def predict_log_proba(self, X):
371:         """Predict class log-probabilities for a given set of time series.
372: 
373:         Note that probability estimates are not guaranteed to match predict
374:         output.
375:         See our :ref:`dedicated user guide section <kernels-ml>`
376:         for more details.
377: 
378:         Parameters
379:         ----------
380:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
381:             Time series dataset.
382: 
383:         Returns
384:         -------
385:         array of shape=(n_ts, n_classes),
386:             Class probability matrix.
387:         """
388:         sklearn_X, *_ = self._preprocess_sklearn(X, fit_time=False)
389:         return self.svm_estimator_.predict_log_proba(sklearn_X)
390: 
391:     def predict_proba(self, X):
392:         """Predict class probability for a given set of time series.
393: 
394:         Note that probability estimates are not guaranteed to match predict
395:         output.
396:         See our :ref:`dedicated user guide section <kernels-ml>`
397:         for more details.
398: 
399:         Parameters
400:         ----------
401:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
402:             Time series dataset.
403: 
404:         Returns
405:         -------
406:         array of shape=(n_ts, n_classes),
407:             Class probability matrix.
408:         """
409:         sklearn_X, *_ = self._preprocess_sklearn(X, fit_time=False)
410:         return self.svm_estimator_.predict_proba(sklearn_X)
411: 
412: 
413: class TimeSeriesSVR(TimeSeriesSVMMixin, RegressorMixin, BaseEstimator):
414:     """Time-series specific Support Vector Regressor.
415: 
416:     Parameters
417:     ----------
418:     C : float, optional (default=1.0)
419:         Penalty parameter C of the error term.
420: 
421:     kernel : string, optional (default='gak')
422:          Specifies the kernel type to be used in the algorithm.
423:          It must be one of 'gak' or a kernel accepted by ``sklearn.svm.SVC``.
424:          If none is given, 'gak' will be used. If a callable is given it is
425:          used to pre-compute the kernel matrix from data matrices; that matrix
426:          should be an array of shape ``(n_samples, n_samples)``.
427: 
428:     degree : int, optional (default=3)
429:         Degree of the polynomial kernel function ('poly').
430:         Ignored by all other kernels.
431: 
432:     gamma : float, optional (default='auto')
433:         Kernel coefficient for 'gak', 'rbf', 'poly' and 'sigmoid'.
434:         For 'gak' kernel, a `RuntimeError` is raised at fit time when value is
435:         close to 0 and therefore not compatible with 'gak' kernel.
436: 
437:         If gamma is 'auto' then:
438: 
439:         - for 'gak' kernel, it is computed based on a sampling of the training
440:           set (cf :ref:`tslearn.metrics.gamma_soft_dtw <fun-tslearn.metrics.gamma_soft_dtw>`).
441:           A `RuntimeError` is raised at fit time when computed value is
442:           close to 0 and therefore not compatible with 'gak' kernel.
443: 
444:         - for other kernels (eg. 'rbf'), 1/n_features will be used.
445: 
446:     coef0 : float, optional (default=0.0)
447:         Independent term in kernel function.
448:         It is only significant in 'poly' and 'sigmoid'.
449: 
450:     tol : float, optional (default=1e-3)
451:         Tolerance for stopping criterion.
452: 
453:     epsilon : float, optional (default=0.1)
454:          Epsilon in the epsilon-SVR model. It specifies the epsilon-tube
455:          within which no penalty is associated in the training loss function
456:          with points predicted within a distance epsilon from the actual
457:          value.
458: 
459:     shrinking : boolean, optional (default=True)
460:         Whether to use the shrinking heuristic.
461: 
462:     cache_size :  float, optional (default=200.0)
463:         Specify the size of the kernel cache (in MB).
464: 
465:     n_jobs : int or None, optional (default=None)
466:         The number of jobs to run in parallel for GAK cross-similarity matrix
467:         computations.
468:         ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context.
469:         ``-1`` means using all processors. See scikit-learns'
470:         `Glossary <https://scikit-learn.org/stable/glossary.html#term-n_jobs>`_
471:         for more details.
472: 
473:     verbose : int, default: 0
474:         Enable verbose output. Note that this setting takes advantage of a
475:         per-process runtime setting in libsvm that, if enabled, may not work
476:         properly in a multithreaded context.
477: 
478:     max_iter : int, optional (default=-1)
479:         Hard limit on iterations within solver, or -1 for no limit.
480: 
481:     random_state : int, RandomState instance or None, optional (default=None)
482:         The seed of the pseudo random number generator to use when shuffling
483:         the data.  If int, random_state is the seed used by the random number
484:         generator; If RandomState instance, random_state is the random number
485:         generator; If None, the random number generator is the RandomState
486:         instance used by `np.random`.
487: 
488:     Attributes
489:     ----------
490:     support_ : array-like, shape = [n_SV]
491:         Indices of support vectors.
492:
